name: Street View House Numbers (SVHN)
description: SVHN is a real-world image dataset for recognizing digits and numbers in house-number images captured from Google Street View.
citation: Netzer, Y., Wang, T., Coates, A., Bissacco, A., Wu, B., & Ng, A. Y. (2011). Reading Digits in Natural Images with Unsupervised Feature Learning. NIPS Workshop on Deep Learning and Unsupervised Feature Learning.
